entries.f3c0ffbb178df4ac: A bank that, under the Banking Act, accepts savings deposits up to the deposit ceiling and invests those savings mainly in securities. Using the post office network of Japan Post Co., Ltd. as its main channel, it provides financial services to customers on a scale of 120 million people. At the end of March 2026, savings totaled ¥186.1 trillion, of which individual savings accounted for more than 90%. Securities totaled ¥145.3 trillion, of which government bonds were ¥41.4 trillion, and “other securities,” including foreign bonds and investment trusts whose main investment target is foreign bonds, were ¥88.2 trillion. The deposit ceiling for savings is ¥13 million each for ordinary savings and fixed-term savings, and ¥5.5 million combined for employee savings (from April 1, 2019). In addition to 235 head offices, branches and other business offices nationwide, it entrusts banking agency services and others to Japan Post Co., Ltd., and has agencies at 19,701 post offices and 3,370 simplified post offices (as of March 31, 2026). The group consists of the bank, 18 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], one equity-method affiliate and others, and forms a single [[term:segment|segment]] for banking. Management is pursued through three business strategies: “Retail Business,” “Market Business” and “Σ Business.” For the fiscal year ended March 2026, consolidated ordinary revenue was ¥2,852,206 million (¥2,522,052 million in the previous fiscal year), and the number of employees was 10,771.
